episodes.synopsis: For years, ordinary high-schooler Kousaka Kyousuke has had an icy relationship with his younger sister Kirino, a star athlete who is also a star student.
episodes.title: My Little Sister Can't Be My Love

episodes.synopsis: While being grilled by Kirino over why he hasn't made any progress in the game she ordered him to complete, it occurs to Kyousuke that she needs some friends that she can talk to without concealing her otaku interests.
episodes.title: My Little Sister Can't Bring Me to an IRL Meet

episodes.synopsis: Kirino finds her first otaku friends at the IRL meet: "Kuroneko" and "Saori Bajeena." They spend their days deep in discussions over their otaku interests. Seeing Kirino this way puts Kyousuke's mind at ease.
episodes.title: My Little Sister Can't Be This Cute

episodes.synopsis: One day, Kirino's non-otaku, "public" friends—Aragaki Ayase and Kurusu Nanako—come over to visit. Kyousuke is harshly told by Kirino to not let her friends see him.
episodes.title: My Little Sister Can't Be Going to Summerket

episodes.synopsis: On the way home from an enjoyable Summerket. They bump into Aragaki Ayase, Kirino's best friend.
episodes.title: My Little Sister's Best Friend Can't Be This XX

episodes.synopsis: Kyousuke is asked about his relationship with Manami by his friend, Akagi. Akagi is exasperated when Kyousuke answers that, although they don't have a romantic relationship, he doesn't want her to be taken by anyone else.
episodes.title: My Childhood Friend Can't Be This Cute

episodes.synopsis: Kyousuke comes home one day and is startled to find Kuroneko loitering in the living room by herself.
episodes.title: My Little Sister Can't Be a Novelist

episodes.synopsis: Kirino has made her debut as an author. Reader response has been overwhelming, and her editor has even better news to report.
episodes.title: My Little Sister Can't Be Animated

episodes.synopsis: Kirino has been acting strangely antsy for the past few days. The reason is that the little sister game she ordered hasn't arrived yet.
episodes.title: My Little Sister Can't Be This Absorbed Into Eroge

episodes.synopsis: One day, Ayase calls Kyousuke out of the blue and asks him to see her. She wants to get Kirino a present, and wants him to think of what she would be happiest to get.
episodes.title: My Little Sister Can't Be Cosplaying Like This

episodes.synopsis: Sent out to buy groceries by his mother, Kyousuke bumps into Manami at the supermarket. They get to talking, and they eventually arrange for Manami to come visit for the first time in ages.
episodes.title: My Little Sister Can't Be This Maid

episodes.synopsis: Ever since the events of the previous episode, Kyousuke has been nervous about his improved relationship with his sister.
episodes.title: My Little Sister's Advice Can't End Here (GOOD END)
